name: qkd_pv16_vport_r3
purpose: Q-ATTN-RATE 2026-10-16: PV16 V port of the KV die (16 per die, ONE master). Replaces the 8-sector double-buffered transposer: with the VMAP=1 V placement each w16 port reads only groups {lane,0}/{lane,1}, every PC streams in the controller's v_consumer_order; the port is a static 2:1 quad select with input + output pin registers and tag checks. Pin-bound (3,276 pins, ~1,230 um2 of cells): 86.4 x 172.8 is the smallest outline at ~6 pins/um per face.

job.purpose: r2 qkd_pv16_vport_r2-r2-b30e76bb9 CLOSED (TT +166.08 / FF +15.01 / DRC 0) but routed native audit FAIL: launch 220.23 ps > 220 on ONE pin out_v_lo[142] (next 207.0; capture 152.5 PASS, rst_n fixed). Path: DFFHQN -> INVx1 drives a 12.1 fF detoured net to the FIRM pin BUF (slew 112 ps) -> HB2 pad -> BUF -> output BUF; the BUF->HB2->BUF pad costs 84 ps on every output. Fix: output pad HB1xp67 (hold_pad.out_cell, S81 VM F6 precedent) ~-29 ps on every output launch; FF output-port hold had +30.37 ps. Inputs keep HB2. 0 cycles, RTL unchanged.

reroute_reason.fix: output hold pad HB2xp67 -> HB1xp67 (hold_pad.out_cell) on every output pin: the FIRM BUF->HB2->BUF output stage costs 84 ps TT per pin; HB1 ~-29 ps per output; FF output-port hold had +30.37 ps. Same RTL, outline and pin faces.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every port at the module boundary: every input (slot/sel/in_v*/in_t*/in_d*) -> *_q, every output (out_valid/out_t/out_v/fault) a flop
